notes.title: Performance Update
notes.notes:
Performance:
There is a significant increase in the frame rate stability across the whole game but specifically on the first scene. (More updates on this issue are forth coming)

Ease of play:
Run speed has been increased 10%
Walk speed has increased 75%
Main shaft elevator speed has increased 50% 
Stair posts in the east silo have changed color for photo sensitive players
Alternate key bindings have been added. *
A block has been added to the swing gate to prevent players from getting stuck on the other side

Bug fix's
A rare bug that caused the bird to be stuck on the ground with wings spread
Camera twist when tapping forward while flying
Failing to play screwdriver animation of levels 3 and 5
Volume on boarded door not adjusting to Sound Effect Volume
Various volume linking to incorrect volume adjusters. **
A rare bug that caused players not to be able to disengage from the crane
UI issue when the crane had deployed
A box under the out building stairs when jumped on a player would get stuck

All bug fix's above have been addressed and resolved.

* Most key bindings relevant to game play can be viewed in the menu -> settings -> controls
or when engaged with a specific game element. (A full list of all key binding for all game elements is forth coming) 

** Most volume related issues have been corrected, however the investigation into any further bad links is ongoing

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that prevented the title settings from being translated in game

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that in rare cases disallowed the player from disconnecting from the silo stair puzzle.
Fixed a bug that could cause the screen to go black when interacting with the pedestal/elevator puzzle

notes.title: Player Request Update
notes.notes:
Video settings added to in game menu & title screen:

    1.Full screen / windowed
    2. Graphics quality
        A. High Fidelity
        B. Balanced
        C. Performant
   3. Screen Resolutions

Audio & Options added to title screen menu
(Note: all audio & option settings will revert to there default after the patch, these will need to be set by the user)

Adjustment for ease of play:
  
  1. Water tank fill time reduced by 75%
  2. Time till receiving the "Bad Ending" was reduced to 24 hours from 40 hours
  3. Overall scene loading times reduced by 15% - 20%
  4. Replaced the use of the "Enter" key with the "Space" key when interacting with object or clearing a 
      tutorial.

Bug Fixes:
  
  1. Corrected Achievement "Un boarded" now unlocks when the last boarded door is opened.
    (Note: if you have already completed this you will receive the achievement when loading into a scene 
    containing a boarded door)
  2. Corrected Achievement "Lowest point" will now trigger properly.
    (Note: if you have already completed this you will receive the achievement when loading into the 
    lowest scene)
  3. Correct Achievement "Notable" will properly trigger when collecting all notes.
    (Note: if you have already completed this you will receive the achievement when loading into any 
    scene containing a note)

Copyright Issues:
  
  This issue was due to a third party claiming the rights to a song that they do not own. The artist with 
  ownership has been informed and action is being taken. While the legal parts are sorted out the song 
  has been temporarily replaced. The original song will be returned as soon as the licensing has been 
  cleared by the provider.
